text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: This is a scoping review focused on ecological determinants of Lutzomyia spp., primarily vector biology and ecology related to leishmaniasis transmission. The study is species-specific and ecological in focus, which is an exclusion criterion. There is no LULC prediction component or spatially explicit LULC outputs. Therefore, it fails core inclusion criteria and meets exclusion criteria related to species/ecological focus unrelated to LULC.)
